import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (colored by Stress Level)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter1 = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', 
                       s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter1, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_bmi = ['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62', '#8da0cb']
ax3.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=colors_bmi, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter2 = ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                       c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', 
                       s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps\n(colored by Age)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=ax4, label='Age')

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors_disorder = ['#a6d854', '#ffd92f', '#e78ac3']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
                                     labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index,
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', 
                                     colors=colors_disorder,
                                     startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Occupation Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts()
ax6.barh(occupation_counts.index, occupation_counts.values, 
         color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Occupation Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Heart Rate vs Stress Level
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
scatter3 = ax7.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                       s=100, alpha=0.6, color='red', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax7.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 8. Gender Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
gender_counts = df['Gender'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e']
ax8.bar(gender_counts.index, gender_counts.values, 
        color=colors_gender, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Gender Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax9.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
